messages.author: 9ec69ca07f36d6a1
messages.subject: Problem with extra blank lines
parts:
I am getting extra blank lines in "asis" output with knitr.  Here's my test program test.Rnw:

\documentclass{article}
<<echo=FALSE>>=
unlink('messages.txt') # Start fresh with each run
hook_log = function(x, options) cat(x, file='messages.txt', append=TRUE)
knit_hooks$set(warning = hook_log, message = hook_log)
@ 

\begin{document}
<<results='asis',echo=FALSE>>=
x <- c('a','b')
cat('----\n')
cat(x, sep='\\\\\n')
cat('xxxx\n')
@ 
\end{document}

The result is:
. . .
\usepackage{alltt}



\begin{document}

----


a\\
b


xxxx



\end{document}

I would appreciate any help.
Thanks
Frank

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Problem with extra blank lines
parts:
Thanks for the report! It should be fixed on Github now. Note the
development version of knitr requires the devel version of evaluate,
so

library(devtools)
install_github('evaluate', 'hadley')
install_github('knitr', 'yihui')

Regards,
Yihui
